name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
blurb: Compound tooltip component with provider, trigger, content, and optional arrow.
description: Radix-based tooltip system with automatic provider wrapping. Exports TooltipProvider, Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, and TooltipContent as a compound component.
use_when: Standard tooltips with simple text content or structured layouts.
avoid_when: Very complex custom content; consider custom components instead.
a11y: Trigger must be focusable; tooltip appears on hover only.
